rivals.reason: The 2007 Porsche Cayenne Turbo offers a sporty drive with a robust 500 horsepower, making it a strong rival for performance-focused buyers.
The 2007 BMW X5 M Sport comes with a power-packed 350 horsepower, competing closely with the AMG's performance and luxury features.
The 2007 Audi Q7 4.2 features a powerful 350 horsepower V8 engine, providing a luxurious SUV alternative with similar performance.
The 2007 Volvo XC90 V8 delivers 315 horsepower along with strong safety ratings, offering a family-friendly SUV option that road-tests well against the AMG.
